name: AI Assignment Grader
description: Grades student assignments from a Google Drive folder with one vision-AI call per file (exam sheet + answer key + answer pages); results are written to Google Sheets and closed with a summary row.

parameters.formDescription: Provide three things: (1) a Google Drive folder link with student submissions (file names must follow NIM_Name or Name_NIM), (2) the exam sheet from the lecturer (PDF or image; the answer key may be included in that file), (3) optionally an extra answer key and per-question weights (e.g. No.1 = 20% No.2 = 30%). Without weights, all questions count equally; final score 0-100.

values.placeholder: Optional. Fill in when the key is not already in the exam file, e.g.: 1. B - value is the guideline...
Optional. Example: No.1 = 20% No.2 = 30%, or 1: 20, 2: 30. Leave empty = all questions weigh the same.

nodes.name: Process One File
nodes.notes: One file per iteration; the 'done' output ends the loop. Do not raise batchSize - files can be skipped.

nodes.name: Delay Between Files
nodes.notes: Delay between files (seconds). Leave empty to use the node default (1 second).
